snippet.title: Nirih Steam Trailer #indiegame #racinggame  #steamnextfest
snippet.description:
NIRIH by ShippableGames

Get ready to fall fast.
You play as Nirih, a masked warrior gliding through the ruins of a fallen world in search of lost souls. With only a few inputs but a high skill ceiling, players will experience a unique mix of flow-based movement, reflex-driven gameplay, and mystical atmosphere. 

Easy to learn — tough to master.

Play the demo & wishlist Nirih on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3291700/Nirih/

All links &  trailer: https://linktr.ee/shippablegames

Key Features:

• Fast-paced, stylish, and precise:
Nirih is a vertical time-attack platformer built around flow. Drop, dash, dive — and refine every run to beat your highscore and unlock new skins.

• Retro meets modern:
Combines pixel-textured, minimalist 3D models with modern shaders and dynamic lighting — for a look that's both nostalgic and fresh.

• Three worlds, three unique flows:
Each region introduces new hazards, mechanics, and pacing — keeping gameplay varied, challenging, and always rewarding.

• Epic boss encounters:
There is a challenging bossfight, combining local mechanics with handcrafted challenges for intense, cinematic battles.

• Simple controls, deep mastery:
With minimal input complexity, Nirih is easy to pick up. But chasing high scores demands mastery of movement, timing, and control.

Nirih is a fun mixture of momentum, precision, and stylish challenge — combining speedrun intensity with a rich, emotional aesthetic. Developed by indie team Shippable Games in Germany, it's a one-of-a-kind journey through skies, storms, and shadows.
